name: Tough Parrot 85
author: shlomo20
description: Gradient pill teal radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from transparent to #7af4ec, box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 10px 1px #7af4ec. Clicking it toggles it: background changes from transparent to conic-gradient(from 300deg at 18% 50%, #e5719e, #7af4ec, #1a3271, #101a2e, #a859a0), background changes from transparent to conic-gradient(from 300deg at 51% 50%, #e5719e, #7af4ec, #1a3271, #101a2e, #a859a0), background changes from transparent to conic-gradient(from 300deg at 84% 50%, #e5719e, #7af4ec, #1a3271, #101a2e, #a859a0).
